title: Drop the investment for growth package
noun: dropping the investment for growth package
headline: Drop growth investment. Saves £0.3bn in 2029-30.
description: The Budget funds strategic technologies, local growth and key industries under one heading. Switch this on to drop it.

baselinePolicy.text: Support for strategic technologies, local growth and key industries is in the forecast (Table 6.1 line 74).
alreadyIncludes: Support for strategic technologies, local growth and key industries is in the forecast (Table 6.1 line 74).

lines.title: Investment for Growth: Support strategic technologies, local growth and key industries

rawSource.note: Reversal on the spending side: the Treasury’s costing with the sign kept (a line that reduced borrowing is spending the reversal adds back; a line that cost money is spending the reversal saves).

caveats: The Treasury’s costing is on the OBR October 2026 forecast, the baseline used here. Effects before the start year are not applied: 2026-27 falls before any Budget of yours.
One scorecard line covers several programmes; dropping it drops them all.

considerations.text: The Treasury’s scorecard figure is the Budget’s own costing of the measure, certified by the OBR as part of its October 2026 forecast.
